biotools.summary: SLOctolyzer is an open-source toolkit for analyzing scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO) images, enabling segmentation and quantification of retinal vessels.  It uses deep learning for accurate segmentation and provides clinically meaningful parameters for retinal vascular assessment.
